artifact.source: exact mirror SHA256, immutable declared Git revision and verified content digest
artifact.host_adapter: existing catalog source and native test pins; inert descriptor only
artifact.license: known declaration plus exact notice bytes and current scoped approval; no legal rights attested
artifact.provenance: retained local fixture/source pins; no contributor independence attested

authority.artifact_review: current independent skill.approve and original SkillInstaller approval
authority.transition_review: current independent skill.review with exact source/profile/evidence binding
authority.release: existing SkillReleases only; separate stage/evaluate/review/publish controls remain
authority.revoke: current skill.revoke for one store and exact archived bundle

compatibility.compatible: unchanged engine/action/input/output/configuration contract; presentation fields retain existing schema
compatibility.breaking: changed contract or schema requires major version and reviewed retain_pins_and_repreview strategy
compatibility.in_flight: immutable original case, approval, operation and source pins
compatibility.rollback: retained old bundle and new increasing profile revision; existing SkillReleases rollback where an activation changed

privacy.erasure: repeat field-specific typed allowlists and original artifact/bundle/resource integrity; preserve valid unrelated rows
privacy.restore_import_uninstall: revoke all extension review/transition/retirement authority and exact corresponding canonical skill approvals
privacy.archived_business_pins: retained; revocation does not rewrite original cases or effects
privacy.external_copies: caller-owned mirror/download/backup copies need separate cleanup
